definitions.explanation: the process of fitting parts together to create a whole product

examples.japanese: {家具|かぐ}の{組|く}み{立|た}てを{自分|じぶん}でした。
この{製品|せいひん}は{組|く}み{立|た}て{式|しき}だ。
{組|く}み{立|た}て{説明書|せつめいしょ}を{読|よ}んでから{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started after reading the assembly instructions.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
{組|く}み{立|た}てる - to assemble, to put together (compound verb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {組|く}み{立|た}て{式|しき} - requiring assembly, build-it-yourself
- {組|く}み{立|た}て{工場|こうじょう} - assembly plant
- {組|く}み{立|た}てライン - assembly line
- {組|く}み{立|た}て{説明書|せつめいしょ} - assembly instructions
- {組|く}み{立|た}て{作業|さぎょう} - assembly work

USAGE:
- IKEA-style furniture
- Manufacturing
- DIY projects
- Model kits (プラモデル)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分解|ぶんかい} - disassembly
